title: Shelter in chic in this modern Dogpatch corner loft in a well maintain
body: Shelter in chic in this modern Dogpatch corner loft in a well maintained boutique elevator building and desirable location. The unit has an excellent layout and is flooded with natural light via floor-to-ceiling windows & approx. 17 ft soaring ceilings. Entry level boasts a modern kitchen with ample storage, stainless steel appliances and breakfast bar, dining and living areas with a cozy fireplace, as well as a massive half guest bathroom with a ton of storage. Upper level features a bedroom with en suite modern full bath. An in-unit laundry and parking with additional storage cabinets complete this unit. The building offers a gym and a roof deck with panoramic views. Walking distance to several trendy restaurants and coffeeshops (Philz coffee, Piccino, Serpentine, Neighbor Bakehouse, and many more), popular Esprit Park, Art Galleries, and SF's popular climbing & boxing gyms. EZ access to freeways, Caltrain, 3rd St Muni line. As the city opens back up, everything at your fingertips!

title: Lovely Studio in Historic Italianate Victorian with Garden
body:
This is a small but charming and cozy studio in a beautiful historic 1880s Italianate Victorian. The location is excellent — close to the numerous restaurants, cafes, and nightlife of the Mission, Castro, Hayes Valley, and Lower Haight. Great access to public transportation and the 101 on/off ramps. Tech shuttle stops and Whole Foods are nearby. This unit sits at the border of Upper Market, Castro, and Mission neighborhoods.
The unit includes:

Multiple large windows with arched Victorian details
Cherry wood and tile flooring throughout
Rear door to lovely quiet (shared) garden with avocado tree
Small closet within unit and dedicated closet in hallway
Fireplace with gas insert
Renovated bathroom with glass-enclosed shower, large-format tile, and floating vanity
Antique chandelier lighting with original ceiling medallion
Soaring 10'4" ceilings with original period molding
Kitchen with cobalt blue tile backsplash, gas range, and stainless refrigerator
Approximately 200 square feet

Unfurnished

title: Impeccably modern 1 bedroom 1 bath condo
body: Impeccably modern 1 bedroom 1 bath condominium located in the vibrant & hip Bernal & SoCha neighborhoods. Facing the quiet rear of the complex, the hustle & bustle of Mission St. is quickly forgotten. An abundance of natural light gleams, w/ sliding glass doors leading to the delightfully spacious, peaceful & sunny patio - great for indoor/outdoor living! Dazzling hardwood floors & stunning light fixtures are sure to delight. Large master bedroom with walk-in closet, providing ample room for your wardrobe. Full-sized brightly remodeled bathroom with shower over tub wont disappoint. Updated kitchen with contemporary cabinets & stainless-steel appliances. Designated garage parking w/ highly coveted storage space. Onsite laundry room located near the unit. Just steps away from all the trendy shops, restaurants, parks & hiking trails this area has to offer with convenient access to major bus lines, commuter shuttles, BART, 101 & 280 Fwys.
